sources.title: SpAItial AI Echo-2: The Free "World Generator" That Turns One Image ...
sources.snippet: Just five months ago, in December 2025, SpAItial AI (then still often called Spatial AI) dropped its first public model, Echo. It was an exciting proof-of-concept: type a prompt or upload a photo and get a navigable 3D world built with 3D Gaussian Splatting. The catch? It lived behind a waitlist. Today the waitlist is gone. Echo-2 is live for everyone at spaitial.ai.
